title: This Mole Has 22 Fingers on Its Nose, and Eats Faster Than You Brake
subject: star-nosed mole

scenes.text: This mole has twenty-two fingers on its nose. What are they for?
They're feelers. The star-nosed mole taps the ground with them and finds tiny prey in the dark.
Its nose has five times as many touch nerve fibers as a human hand.
Scientists timed it. The mole can decide something is food and eat it in as little as one hundred twenty milliseconds.
A driver needs about six hundred fifty milliseconds just to hit the brakes.
So those twenty-two fingers aren't smelling anything. They're a touch machine, and the fastest eater of any mammal.

description:
This mole has twenty-two fingers on its nose.
The star-nosed mole can identify food and eat it in as little as 120 milliseconds, the fastest recorded for any mammal.
